about_the_game:
Scales and Spells is a cute and cozy RPG about enchanting and farming.

The world ends in a sudden cataclysm. Unconscious, you are seemingly taken to a void and your fate is discussed by a group of dragons. You wake up on a floating island, a place protected by the Dragon of Wisdom. You are guided to discover your future destiny, assuming the role of a local enchanter, helping all around you by developing and leveraging your magical skills.

Features:

  • Gather wild ingredients and use them to enchant items and potions

  • Grow and take care of your own plants to serve as enchantment ingredients

  • Gain experience and improve your skills, becoming more powerful over time

  • Run a shop every weekend, selling enchanted goods and crafted trinkets

  • Make new friends among the population of Dragon Islands

  • Dive deep into the cavernous mountain to find new rare crafting materials

  • Draw every critter you encounter and every material you find and complete the Library collection with the help from Dragon of Wisdom

  • Participate in contests and mini-games during seasonal festivals

  • Catch every fish on the islands!

  • Cook a variety of food to grant you buffs, share it with others or sell for a good coin!

  • Customize the appearance of your character, your farm and your house

  • Play with a friend in a local or steam remote co-op!

short_description: Enchant trinkets and items, build and run a weekly enchantment shop, harvest ingredient plants on your farm! Become friends with the locals and explore the Dragon Islands. Welcome to Scales and Spells, a cozy and cute mixture of farm and a shop sim.
